cards.title: Cross the Intracoastal and head for the initial
instructions: Cross the Intracoastal Waterway at 2,500' MSL or above
Approaching from the north, overfly the wildlife refuge at 3,000' AGL or above
Descend to 1,000' MSL · 200 KIAS for the 2 NM initial
Extreme caution descending to the initial: traffic may be on course rules at 1,500' over the Intracoastal
cards.detail: The binder gives the ICW altitude and the wildlife refuge altitude for entries from Mustang and Foxtrot, but no step-by-step track. Check with an instructor.
cards.source: Binder, pp. 39–40; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 2, slide 37.
